name: cortina_overlay_visual_intelligence_v1
purpose: Shared visual intelligence for infographic/A+ overlays. Keep this file focused so PR review stays easy.

lighting.quality: soft even illumination on fabric folds; gentle window light; no harsh HDR bloom; no muddy shadows on callout cards
lighting.color_temperature: neutral warm for Indian home interiors

typography.heading_font: Montserrat Bold (or closest clean modern geometric sans-serif bold)
typography.body_font: Open Sans Regular (or closest clean humanist sans-serif)
typography.heading_size_feel: large and scannable; short title max 6 words
banned: em dash or en dash characters

callout_card.layout: side_panel_icons preferred; keep curtain product clearly visible (at least 55% of frame)
callout_card.shape: rounded rectangle cards with soft shadow and thin warm-beige accent border (#DCC7A1)
callout_card.background: solid opaque white (#FFFFFF) or soft cream card fill - never translucent glass over busy fabric
callout_card.padding: comfortable internal padding so text never touches card edges
callout_card.icon: small circular charcoal or cool-gray badge with simple white symbol; one icon per callout
callout_card.alignment: left-aligned text inside card; consistent card widths in a vertical stack on the right third
callout_card.leader_lines: thin solid charcoal lines optional; do not cross through product focal folds
callout_card.readability_rule: AA-like contrast: dark text on solid light card only

composition_guardrails.product_priority: curtain pattern and drape remain the hero
composition_guardrails.props: minimal supporting furniture only; never crowd callouts

render_prompt_must_include: exact callout titles and details from overlays.callouts
solid white/cream card backgrounds with charcoal Montserrat-like headings
